causal_explanation: The deprecated policy (v1, 90-day) was retrieved above the current policy (v2, 30-day). At step 2 the agent committed to the deprecated source; from there the unauthorized refund and the unsupported outage ticket follow as downstream effects.
suggested_guardrail: Filter retrieval to current sources, or require a current-policy check before issue_refund.
regression_test_idea: Stale-policy refund task must end with refund_issued=False and a clean ticket.
